sn42.10:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn42.10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena rājantepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
sn42.10:1.3: kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajatanti.
sn42.10:2.1: tena kho pana samayena maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
sn42.10:2.2: atha kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca
sn42.10:2.4: na kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ na paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatāti.
sn42.10:2.5: asakkhi kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
sn42.10:2.6: atha kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.10:2.7: idha bhante rājantepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
sn42.10:2.8: kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajatanti.
sn42.10:2.9: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante taṃ parisaṃ etadavocaṃ
sn42.10:2.11: na kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ na paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatāti.
sn42.10:2.12: asakkhiṃ khohaṃ bhante taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
sn42.10:2.13: kaccāhaṃ bhante evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva bhagavato homi na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaromi na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti.
sn42.10:3.1: taggha tvaṃ gāmaṇi evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva me ahosi na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhasi dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākarosi na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
sn42.10:3.2: na hi gāmaṇi kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ na paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā.
sn42.10:3.3: yassa kho gāmaṇi jātarūparajataṃ kappati pañcapi tassa kāmaguṇā kappanti
sn42.10:3.4: yassa pañca kāmaguṇā kappanti (tassapi jātarūparajataṃ kappati) ekaṃsenetaṃ gāmaṇi dhāreyyāmi assamaṇadhammo asakyaputtiyadhammoti.
sn42.10:3.6: tiṇaṃ tiṇatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ dāruṃ dārutthikena pariyesitabbaṃ sakaṭaṃ sakaṭatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ puriso purisatthikena pariyesitabbo.
sn42.10:3.7: na tvevāhaṃ gāmaṇi kenaci pariyāyena jātarūparajataṃ sāditabbaṃ pariyesitabbanti vadāmīti.
